decisive_items: Angiotensin-converting enzyme level was elevated at 77 U/L
response.rationale: Non-caseating granulomas with elevated ACE and hepatosplenomegaly strongly favor systemic sarcoidosis, whereas Crohn's disease would not typically elevate ACE or cause hepatosplenomegaly with these granulomas.

rejected.why: GI symptoms and mucosal changes are nonspecific and lack the systemic ACE elevation and granuloma pattern characteristic of sarcoidosis.
